# Intervals {#top}

The functions of this section make intervals: views of consecutive integers, used as sources of a column of
integers. An interval can be passed to `index_set::relational::from`, `cross` or `in`, or returned by the callable
of `lateral` or `in`.

Creating an interval takes constant time, and its values are computed as they are read. The two ends are first
converted to their common type. Each value is converted to the integer type of the column that it fills.

In use: [the guide](../guide/relational-algebra.md).

## `closed` {#closed}

!!! abstract "`dreamor::interval::closed` - function"

    ```cpp
    template <detail::integer_end A, detail::integer_end B>
    auto closed(A first, B last)
    ```

    Returns a view of the integers from `first` to `last`, both included: `first, first + 1, ..., last`.

    - **Takes:** `first` and `last` must each be an integer of any integer type, or a column that holds an integer.
    - **Returns:** An empty view if `last` is less than `first`. The elements are of an internal type, and each element is converted to the integer type of the column that it fills.
    - **Contract:** The common type of the two ends can hold the value of each end. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_ends_in_common_type)) If an interval includes its last end and is not empty, the last end is less than the largest value of the common type of the ends. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_closed_below_largest))

## `open` {#open}

!!! abstract "`dreamor::interval::open` - function"

    ```cpp
    template <detail::integer_end A, detail::integer_end B>
    auto open(A first, B last)
    ```

    Returns a view of the integers between `first` and `last`, neither included: `first + 1, ..., last - 1`.

    - **Takes:** `first` and `last` must each be an integer of any integer type, or a column that holds an integer.
    - **Returns:** An empty view if `last` is less than or equal to `first + 1`. The elements are of an internal type, and each element is converted to the integer type of the column that it fills.
    - **Contract:** The common type of the two ends can hold the value of each end. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_ends_in_common_type))

## `closedOpen` {#closedopen}

!!! abstract "`dreamor::interval::closedOpen` - function"

    ```cpp
    template <detail::integer_end A, detail::integer_end B>
    auto closedOpen(A first, B last)
    ```

    Returns a view of the integers from `first` to `last`, with `first` included and `last` excluded: `first, ..., last - 1`.

    - **Takes:** `first` and `last` must each be an integer of any integer type, or a column that holds an integer.
    - **Returns:** An empty view if `last` is less than or equal to `first`. The elements are of an internal type, and each element is converted to the integer type of the column that it fills.
    - **Contract:** The common type of the two ends can hold the value of each end. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_ends_in_common_type))

## `openClosed` {#openclosed}

!!! abstract "`dreamor::interval::openClosed` - function"

    ```cpp
    template <detail::integer_end A, detail::integer_end B>
    auto openClosed(A first, B last)
    ```

    Returns a view of the integers from `first` to `last`, with `first` excluded and `last` included: `first + 1, ..., last`.

    - **Takes:** `first` and `last` must each be an integer of any integer type, or a column that holds an integer.
    - **Returns:** An empty view if `last` is less than or equal to `first`. The elements are of an internal type, and each element is converted to the integer type of the column that it fills.
    - **Contract:** The common type of the two ends can hold the value of each end. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_ends_in_common_type)) If an interval includes its last end and is not empty, the last end is less than the largest value of the common type of the ends. ([checked in a debug build](debug-build-checks.md#interval_closed_below_largest))
